title: NUL (U+0000) in a header passes slice_codepoint_bounded untouched and the write path still 500s
detail: NUL is valid UTF-8: mist parses it, the helper keeps codepoint 0, and Postgres rejects 0x00 in text — consent//apply inserts still fail, the exact 500 class this fix exists to eliminate. Pre-existing, raw-socket clients only.
recommended_fix: Reject or strip C0 control characters (0x00-0x1F) in slice_codepoint_bounded (or filter header bytes once upstream) so no stored evidence value can trip Postgres' NUL rejection.

title: Doc comment claims UA/IP values are 'never displayed or parsed' — the DSAR export serializes them to the applicant
detail: The mid-grapheme-cut justification rests on a consumer map that omits the DSAR export: a dangling ZWJ or lone emoji member lands in the data subject's export document. JSON stays valid; impact is cosmetic display.
recommended_fix: Correct the module comment to name the DSAR export consumer, or accept the trade-off explicitly; if mangled emoji in exports is unacceptable, grapheme-slice at the display boundary.
